newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan posts Y437.4 bln surplus in 1996/97 budget.
newsitem.headline: Japan posts Y437.4 bln surplus in 1996/97 budget.

text.p: Japan posted a surplus of 437.4 billion yen in the state budget for 1996/97 ended on March 31, 1997, which it plans to use mainly to redeem government bonds, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Wednesday.
Under law, the government must use half of any surplus to redeem government bonds. "We would also like to use the other half as much as we can to redeem the bonds, a MOF official told reporters.
The ministry has said it expects the worth of outstanding government bonds to total about 254 trillion yen at the end of March 1998.
